name: post.mark
description: Sets a post's stage by hand, as the idea page does: draft, scheduled or posted. Kept apart from publishing: jobs not yet sent are cancelled, an account already live stays live. Scheduled needs a day and an account; posted is final. A post marked while it still has waiting jobs loses them, even at the same stage: marked is planned, never sent. Marked posted, a feed post or a reel for Instagram links each roster person it names as a collaborator or a tag to the brand for good.
sql:
with p as (select * from brandbase.posts x where x.id = :id and x.brand_id = :brand and (brandbase.post_stage(x.id) <> :stage or exists (select 1 from brandbase.post_jobs j where j.post_id = x.id and j.status not in ('live', 'uploading')))),
cancelled as (delete from brandbase.post_jobs j using p where j.post_id = p.id and j.status <> 'live' returning j.id),
marked as (
  update brandbase.posts x set marked = case when :stage = 'draft' then null else :stage end,
    version = x.version + 1, updated_at = now()
  from p where x.id = p.id
  returning x.*
),
confirmed as (
  insert into brandbase.influencer_brands as x (influencer_id, brand_id, org_id, source, post_id)
  select distinct a.influencer_id, b.id, a.org_id, 'posted', q.id
  from marked q join brandbase.brands b on b.id = q.brand_id
  cross join lateral brandbase.post_handles(q.draft) as h(handle)
  join brandbase.influencer_accounts a on a.platform = 'instagram' and a.handle = h.handle and a.org_id = b.org_id
  where :stage = 'posted' and q.format <> 'story' and 'ig' = any (q.channels)
  on conflict (influencer_id, brand_id) do update set source = 'posted', post_id = excluded.post_id
  where x.source <> 'posted'
  returning x.influencer_id
)
select brandbase.post_json(to_jsonb(m), coalesce((
  select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(j)) from brandbase.post_jobs j where j.post_id = m.id and j.status = 'live'), '[]')) as result
from marked m
union all
select brandbase.post_json(x) from brandbase.posts x
where x.id = :id and x.brand_id = :brand and not exists (select 1 from p)
